references.text: The bronze basin with water in the tabernacle that priests used for ritual cleansing, which is the background for the holy water mentioned here.
Another ritual use of a clay jar with water in purification ceremonies, here for leprosy.
Dust from the floor is used in purification rituals, parallel to the dust from the tabernacle's floor.
Use of water in sacred rituals at the tabernacle in connection with priestly consecration.
Living water in a clay jar used in the purification ritual with the red heifer, similar use of holy water.
The consecration of the tabernacle and its furnishings, explaining why the dust from the floor was holy.
